theorem my_filter_length_le (p : Int → Bool) (l : List Int) :
    (l.filter p).length ≤ l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>

    | false =>

        simp [hpa]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

theorem my_filter_perm (p : Int → Bool) (l : List Int) :
    (l.filter p ++ l.filter (fun x => !p x)).Perm l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases hpa : p a with

        refine List.perm_middle.trans ?_
